intent: Identify the region with the highest average revenue per active customer last quarter, excluding trial accounts.

execution.artifact: SELECT c.region, SUM(r.amount) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN revenue r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.account_type != 'trial' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

explicit.basis: The contract records the intended measure, filters, join, grouping, and ranking.

schema_valid.basis: The example assumes all referenced schema elements exist.

operator_faithful.basis: The executed SQL computes total revenue rather than revenue per active customer.
